title: ArtHub - Online Art Marketplace
name: ArtHub - A Modern Online Art Marketplace
shortDescription: A full-stack digital art marketplace where artists can showcase, manage, and sell artwork while buyers can securely discover, purchase, and interact with their favorite creations.
fullDescription: ArtHub is a feature-rich full-stack online art marketplace designed to connect talented artists with art enthusiasts worldwide. The platform enables artists to upload, organize, and manage their digital artwork through a dedicated dashboard, while buyers can browse collections, search and filter artworks, make secure Stripe payments, leave reviews after purchasing, and manage their purchases from a personalized dashboard. Role-based authentication ensures a secure experience for Buyers, Artists, and Administrators, while the responsive UI delivers a smooth experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
overview: ArtHub is a modern MERN Stack marketplace that simplifies the process of buying and selling digital artwork. It combines beautiful UI design with powerful marketplace functionality including secure authentication, advanced search, filtering, Stripe payments, artist dashboards, admin management, analytics, and responsive user experiences.
problem: Many digital artists struggle to showcase and monetize their work due to fragmented platforms, limited portfolio visibility, and complicated selling processes. Buyers also lack a centralized marketplace where they can easily discover, purchase, and manage high-quality artwork from independent creators.
solution: Developed a centralized online marketplace where artists can publish and manage artwork while buyers can securely browse, purchase, and review digital art. The platform features role-based dashboards, advanced filtering, Stripe payment integration, and powerful administrative tools to provide a complete marketplace experience.
features: Role-based authentication for Buyers, Artists, and Admins
Secure login with Better Auth, JWT, and Google Authentication
Advanced artwork search, filtering, sorting, and pagination
Admin dashboard with analytics and user management
Artwork reviews and commenting after successful purchase
Responsive design optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile
Modern UI with loading states, animations, and smooth interactions
architecture: MERN Stack with Next.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Better Auth, Stripe, jwt,
challenges: One of the biggest challenges was implementing a scalable role-based architecture for Buyers, Artists, and Admins while keeping authorization secure throughout the application. Integrating Stripe payments with order validation, managing protected dashboard routes, optimizing large artwork collections with filtering and pagination, and ensuring smooth state synchronization between the frontend and backend required careful planning and clean architecture.
futurePlans: Future improvements include AI-powered artwork recommendations, artist verification badges, wishlist and favorites, auction functionality, real-time notifications, live chat between buyers and artists, advanced sales analytics, multi-language support, and Progressive Web App (PWA) capabilities for an even better marketplace experience.

title: AdoptNest - Online Pet Adoption Platform
name: AdoptNest - A Online Pets Adopts Platform
shortDescription: A modern pet adoption platform with search, filter, and real-time adoption tracking.
fullDescription: AdoptNest is a fully responsive, modern pet adoption web application built to streamline the process of finding and rehoming pets. It provides a seamless interface where animal lovers can search, filter, and sort through available pets based on species, breed, and location. The platform also features an intuitive user dashboard, allowing users to list pets for adoption, manage their active listings, and track adoption requests in real time.
overview: AdoptNest is a fully responsive, modern pet adoption web application built to streamline the process of finding and rehoming pets. It provides a seamless interface where animal lovers can search, filter, and sort through available pets based on species, breed, and location. The platform also features an intuitive user dashboard, allowing users to list pets for adoption, manage their active listings, and track adoption requests in real time.
problem: Pet adoption processes are often fragmented and rely on outdated systems. Finding available pets requires visiting multiple shelters physically, and there's no centralized way to track adoption requests or manage pet listings efficiently.
solution: Built a centralized web platform that connects pet owners looking to rehome pets with potential adopters. Implemented real-time filtering, search, and an intuitive dashboard for managing listings and tracking adoption requests seamlessly.
features: Advanced search and filter by species, breed, and location
User dashboard for listing and managing pets
Secure authentication with Better-Auth and JWT
challenges: Implementing real-time adoption request tracking and managing state across complex user dashboards. Setting up secure user authentication with Better-Auth while maintaining session persistence across separate client/server environments.
futurePlans: Integrate interactive mapping to find nearby animal shelters, add a video-calling feature for pet shelter interviews, and support user-to-shelter messaging out of the box.

title: KeenKeper – Connect & Share Social App
name: KeenKeper – Connect & Share Social App
shortDescription: A React-based social media frontend with posts, profiles, and data visualization.
fullDescription: This is a React-based social media frontend design where users can see posts, profiles, and UI interactions. It is built to practice component-based architecture and responsive design with dynamic data visualization using Recharts.
overview: This is a React-based social media frontend design where users can see posts, profiles, and UI interactions. It is built to practice component-based architecture and responsive design.
problem: Modern social platforms are often bloated and slow. There's a need for lightweight, fast social media interfaces that prioritize clean UX and component-based architecture.
solution: Built a React-based social media frontend focusing on component reusability, clean routing, and interactive data visualization with Recharts to demonstrate engagement analytics.
features: Dynamic post feed with interactive UI
Smooth page transitions with React Router
challenges: Designing an interactive, fluid UI experience with dynamic data visualization using Recharts. Managing smooth routing and page transitions without losing active UI states.
futurePlans: Develop the backend API endpoints to support user signup, real-time posting, likes, comments, and direct chat messaging.

title: SunCart – Summer Special Product Store
name: SunCart A Summer Special Product Sell Site
shortDescription: A Next.js e-commerce app with Better Auth and seamless cart management.
fullDescription: Suncart is a full-stack e-commerce web application featuring secure and modern authentication using Better Auth. It provides seamless product browsing, cart management, and checkout functionality with a focus on performance, scalability, and user experience.
overview: Suncart is a full-stack e-commerce web application featuring secure and modern authentication using Better Auth. It provides seamless product browsing, cart management, and checkout functionality with a focus on performance, scalability, and user experience.
problem: Many e-commerce sites suffer from poor authentication flows and slow page loads. Users need a fast, secure shopping experience with modern authentication methods.
solution: Built with Next.js for optimal performance and SEO, integrated Better Auth for secure social and credential login, and optimized product imagery for fast load times.
challenges: Implementing secure social and credential login using Better Auth with server actions in Next.js. Optimizing high-resolution product imagery to ensure fast page loads.
futurePlans: Integrate Stripe payment processing flow, build a comprehensive admin portal, and add SMS notifications for order tracking.
